author: Is-that-vodka
body:
Not gonna lie, if you noped out before 150 due to it being too grindy I don't think this game is for you.

Like you could easy hit 150 in a couple days not even knowing much about the game. It doesn't even really start to get grindy til way after there either. Like 215+ it starts to slow down, but you're miles away from 215 at 150.

I'm a new player myself starting Feb 1sg this year and reached 227 already. I dunno what content is new and what isn't from when you left but from what I can tell there hasn't been huge changes to game since you decided you had to grind too much and it's not for you.

It's a great game however and you don't need to really progress quickly at all. Just log in a do some dungeons when you can be bothered or slay some raids. 

But if the grind bothers you now it's only gonna get worse as you progress.

author: [deleted]
body:
You need to join an active kingdom or the game will feel pretty lonely. T7/T8 were the worst for me because I was so behind on gear that fighting anything my level sucked. 

Kingdom raids give good exp and access to many gears that'll greatly speed up your progression. Orn and EXP boosting gear will also greatly help. 

Honestly I felt the grind at T2, lol. But once I figured out a way to play that I enjoyed that melted away.

author: [deleted]
body:
The longer you wait to come back, the more time you save grinding weak gear and pets that get continuously upgraded at pretty much all ranks. 

So by not playing now, you're actually grinding harder than you were when you quit!
